crossRefs.note: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to…
Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

parallels.note: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

translations.web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
translations.bsb: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Seven,” they said.
translations.kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
translations.asv: And when the seven among the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces took ye up? And they say unto him, Seven.
